notes: v1.4.0 美甲第一版上线后的文案修正。美甲行业的硬拦截逻辑已经生效，但后台预览里仍把「灰指甲」这类问题提示成「食品安全规则」，安全开关也还写着「有人说吃出问题」。v1.4.1 把这些文案改成美甲语境：预览命中红线时显示「健康安全红线」；美甲行业下安全开关显示「有人提到指甲健康问题，立刻找我」；说明改成灰指甲、感染、发炎、流脓、流血、伤口、明显疼痛、起水泡等情况。只改后台文案，不改数据库；已有设置、聊天记录、预约记录不会丢；美甲和餐饮的实际拦截逻辑保持不变。
notesEn: A wording fix after the first nail-salon release. The nail health-safety logic already worked, but the admin preview still described nail fungus cases as a food-safety rule, and the safety toggle still said someone got ill from food. v1.4.1 changes those labels into nail-salon wording: preview hits now say health-safety red line, and nail mode shows a nail-health issue toggle covering fungus, infection, inflammation, pus, bleeding, wounds, strong pain, blisters, and similar cases. Admin wording only; no database change. Existing settings, chats, and reservations are preserved, and the actual nail/restaurant safety logic is unchanged.
